turnos.pregunta: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
consultas: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
turnos.respuesta:
Removal is the least predictable part of any job — modern strippable papers come away cleanly, while older or painted-over layers can be slow and sometimes reveal wall repairs underneath. That's why it really needs eyes on it rather than a guess from here.

If you'd like, I can pass your details to the team so they can take a look when you're ready.
